recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸片可見成團聚集的腫瘤細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質細顆粒狀、細胞質界線不清，部分細胞彼此擠壓並埋在淡粉紅纖維狀背景中，另見許多被壓碎的細胞；成團（cohesive）排列是非造血腫瘤轉移的線索。
features: Cohesive clusters of intermediate to large tumor cells with round to oval nuclei
Finely granular chromatin with occasional small nucleoli; high N:C ratio
Indistinct, pale cytoplasmic borders with cells merging into a pale pink fibrillary background
Nuclear crowding/molding and numerous crushed cells with smeared chromatin
Blue-green lysed red cells and stromal material in background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several cohesive aggregates of non-hematopoietic-appearing tumor cells. The cells have round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and scant ill-defined cytoplasm, and they lie within a faint pink fibrillary matrix; nuclear molding and crush artifact are prominent. Definite rosettes are not evident in this field. The cohesive growth pattern argues against acute leukemia, and in conjunction with CD45-negative/CD56-positive flow cytometry and synaptophysin/NSE positivity, findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are dispersed single cells in a clean background and are CD45+/TdT+, unlike these cohesive CD45-negative clusters.
Clusters of small round cells without neuropil; distinguished by membranous CD99, NKX2.2, and EWSR1 rearrangement.
Blasts may clump and appear cohesive, but they are CD45 dim-positive and CD41/CD61 positive rather than synaptophysin positive.
